title: InferenceCostModelInput
description: Inputs for scripts/inference-cost-model.js (PLAN.md §E). Every price and throughput is an operator-supplied placeholder or measurement; this schema cannot tell a quote from a guess, so the input must say which it is in `note`.

$schema.description: Optional editor association with this schema file.

note.description: Provenance, for example 'example, not a quote' or the quote ids and date checked.

hours.description: Length of the measurement or billing window in hours.

requests.description: Requests in the window. Startup and storage are amortized over this count for rented-warm.

input_tokens.description: I: fresh input tokens per request.

cached_read_tokens.description: R: input tokens read from a prompt cache per request.

cache_write_tokens.description: W: input tokens written to a prompt cache per request.

output_tokens.description: O: generated output tokens per request.

success_rate.description: Fraction of requests that produce a successful task (0 < rate <= 1). Cost per successful task divides by this.

prefill_tokens_per_sec.description: Measured prompt-processing throughput at the stated concurrency.

decode_tokens_per_sec.description: Measured output throughput at the stated concurrency.

cached_read_tokens_per_sec.description: Optional measured throughput for cached-read tokens. Omit to charge them at prefill throughput (conservative).

concurrency.description: Concurrency at which the two throughput numbers were measured. It is recorded, not used to multiply throughput.

hourly_usd.description: Rented GPU rate in USD per GPU-hour, from a complete quote.

occupancy.description: Steady-state fraction of paid GPU wall time that is busy, excluding the one-time startup. Billed steady-state time is busy / occupancy.

idle_policy.description: What idle time costs: the GPU rate, standby_hourly_usd, or nothing.

standby_hourly_usd.description: Idle rate when idle_policy is 'standby' (required in that case).

startup_seconds.description: Cold start per window: download, load, and warm-up. Charged at the GPU rate once, in addition to the occupancy allocation, and amortized over window.requests.

storage_gb.description: Model/artifact storage held for the window.

hourly_usd.description: Scale-to-zero per-second rate in USD per GPU-hour. No idle charge is modelled.

startup_seconds.description: Cold start charged on each scale-up.

requests_per_cold_start.description: Requests served per cold start before scaling down. 1 = every request pays a cold start.

storage_gb.description: Artifact storage held for the window.

input_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale input-token rate per million tokens.

cached_read_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale cached-read rate per million tokens.

cache_write_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale cache-write rate per million tokens.

output_usd_per_million.description: Wholesale output-token rate per million tokens.

per_request_usd.description: Fixed fee per request, if the agreement has one.

success_rate.description: Optional provider-specific success rate; falls back to request.success_rate.
